candidates.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
candidates.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

candidates.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
candidates.summary: See how Legora uses OpenAI models, ChatGPT, and Codex to accelerate legal workflows, expand contract analysis, and free lawyers to focus on higher-value work.

candidates.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
candidates.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

candidates.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
candidates.summary: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

candidates.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Property Finder found that 96.8% of their vision-AI evaluation labels were inherited from the incumbent model, hiding its true accuracy. See how they built unbiased ground truth, applied evolutionary prompt optimization, and selected a more accurate, cost-effective model on Amazon Bedrock, cutting cost by 86% across 11 image-quality attributes.

candidates.title: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization
candidates.summary: In this post, we show how Exowatt used Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization to build a repeatable AI pipeline that produces task-specific fine-tuned models for two deployment targets, edge and cloud, achieving higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49x lower cost.
